purpose: One retrospective, explicitly specified pipeline to distinguish Real-missed associations from FDR threshold rescue after adding genuine bulk-only patients
status: protocol fixed before this run; not a prospective preregistration
clinical_unit: patient, never generated cell or repeated draw

composition.universe: all43 fine leukocyte labels excluding RBC/Platelet
composition.rare_primary: Real patient mean<1% and median<1% PBMC; rarity is a label applied after all43 correction
composition.primary_FDR: BH43 per endpoint per cohort, constant/nonestimable P=1; q<0.05

test_engine.severity: two-sided Spearman, scipy asymptotic t approximation with tie ranks
test_engine.death: two-sided Mann-Whitney U; scipy auto rule applied per feature, not per matrix; exact if min(n_case,n_control)<=8 and no ties, otherwise asymptotic with continuity correction
test_engine.scores: within-cohort-source rankINT then Real/New concatenation; constant scores become0
test_engine.constant_or_nonestimable: P=1 and status flag; retain in fixed correction denominator

rescue_definitions.strict_Real_missed: Real P>=0.05 and Combined primary q<0.05
rescue_definitions.FDR_rescue: Real q>=0.05 and Combined primary q<0.05
rescue_definitions.new_support: report New P,q,effect direction separately; pooled selection is not independent validation
rescue_definitions.de_novo_cell_identity: not established by this label-based screen

transcriptome.universe: all common raw-H5AD rare subset labels, all unique shared gene symbols; record mapping
transcriptome.normalization: CP10K over shared genes then log1p per cell
transcriptome.eligible_celltype_primary: at least10 Real and10 genuineNew patients with>=3cells; at least3 deaths and3survivors in each arm
transcriptome.ineligible_celltype: export coverage and reason, do not claim null biology
transcriptome.primary_gene_FDR: all shared genes per celltype and endpoint, constant P=1, q<0.05
transcriptome.global_gene_FDR: also BH over every eligible celltype x gene per endpoint, and joint endpoints sensitivity
transcriptome.targeted_markers: 20 historical HSPC markers are a separately labeled retrospective panel, not genome-wide discovery
transcriptome.fidelity: patient-level shared Real/PBISC correlation for candidate genes; no same-day equivalence claim

robustness.composition: source-stratified phenotype permutation for all43, same declared cohort and endpoints
no_conflation: significance difference is not difference significance
source rankINT is not absolute calibration
wave is not individual steroid exposure
all-visit association is not early prediction
gene-family FDR is not complete historical selection correction

CI_contract: same shared bootstrap_matrix for reported composition/RNA/module CIs:50,000fixed-score patient resamples, rho stratified by source, AUC stratified by source x outcome; stable named seeds; INT maps and generation fixed
outputs: all tables and claim flags generated by shared code; preserve all null/opposite results; hash inputs; retain old folders unchanged
